note: Both sets invent airfoil names not present in the legends (Set A: FFA-W3-3, FFA-W3-2, SNL-FFA; Set B: FFA-W3-1 through FFA-W3-6, plus a misread 'SNL-FFA-WFA-W3-500'), but Set B does so more often and additionally asserts cl = 0.0 at angle of attack 0 deg for four airfoils, which contradicts plot (a) where the curves sit near cl ≈ 0.5–0.8 at 0 deg. Set A correctly captures all seven Reynolds-number legend entries and several plausible readings of the cl/cd peaks and polar points for real airfoils (e.g. FFA-W3-211 peak ≈120, FFA-W3-360 peak ≈75). Set A's errors are mostly its fabricated short-name entities and a couple of questionable cl values, so it is the more faithful set overall.
